from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EarningsPerShare(BaseModel):
    """Captures the per-share earnings data found in a single financial filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as stated in the document")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="Description of the metric (e.g., 'basic net loss per common share')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the earnings per share")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text snippet containing the label and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[EarningsPerShare]
